# Data Source: stripe_product_feature

An entitlement feature attached to a product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_product_feature" "gold_search" {
  product = stripe_product.gold.id
  id      = stripe_product_feature.gold_search.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `product` - (Required) The ID of the parent object.
* `id` - (Required) The ID of the product feature to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `entitlement_feature` - The ID of the [Feature](https://docs.stripe.com/api/entitlements/feature) object attached to this product.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
